title: Second voice download: 'you have everything you need'
summary: Brent tells of Second voice download: 'you have everything you need', about unspecified at an unknown place, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: The second one I got which was time uh the download was you are you have everything you need

plain: A witness named Brent says he has received messages he calls "downloads", which come to him like a voice in his mind. He says the second one he got told him: "you have everything you need." He gives no time or place for it.
